row.evidence: Tempo's help centre says "JIT (Just-In-Time) Provisioning is not supported. New users will need to be invited and assigned to the application in both Strategic Roadmaps and your Identity Provider"; SAML SSO is on Professional ($99/editor/mo) and no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: New row. Roadmunk has migrated to Tempo and is sold as Strategic Roadmaps; roadmunk.com redirects to tempo.io/products/roadmaps. Plans per editor/month billed annually: Starter $19 ('For a single roadmapper', so skipped as team plan), Business $49 ('For small teams who want to collaborate'), Professional $99, Enterprise custom; reviewers are extra seats. SAML SSO (Okta, Entra, OneLogin, PingID guides) is on Professional and Enterprise. No SCIM and no JIT: users are invited manually or by CSV import, deactivated with a toggle and deleted from the Inactive Users list. A GraphQL API (Business and up, 1/5/custom tokens) can list/get users, invite Collaborators/Reviewers and inactivate users, so api_tax is false. Okta's Roadmunk app is SAML+SWA only. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented: the 343 Strategic Roadmaps help pages contain no SCIM or provisioning article, and the user-management article says JIT is not supported and users must be invited in both Strategic Roadmaps and the IdP. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Account-wide API access token sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; only Account Admins can create/revoke; tokens carry admin-level privileges and live two years.

capabilities.notes: Create/invite supports only Collaborator and Reviewer roles; 'update' for users is limited to inactivating; delete is marked as coming soon in the CRUD table.

endpoints.purpose: Create and invite a Collaborator or Reviewer (email, first name, last name, account role)
Inactivate a user (user ID and email)
List users by search string or account role (paged with limit/offset)
Get a single user by userID

limitations.text: Only Reviewer and Collaborator users can be created via the API; Account Admin and User Manager roles must be assigned in the app.
The only user update the API supports is inactivation; deleting users is not yet available.
No REST API; GraphQL only, and no separate test environment.

user_api.notes: Regional gateways: app-gateway (North America), eu-gateway and apac-gateway.roadmunk.com; VPC customers use their own gateway. API tokens: Business 1, Professional 5, Enterprise custom; Starter and trial 0. Operation names below come from the sample-query screenshots on each help page (the page text names the operation only in prose).

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated May 2020) marks SAML and SWA only (read from page markup); no SCIM or provisioning ticks.

entra.notes: Microsoft Learn SSO tutorial only; roadmunk-provisioning-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: Google login is a per-user login method, not a Workspace SAML/provisioning app.

onelogin.notes: Vendor's OneLogin guide uses OneLogin's generic SAML Custom Connector, not a catalogue app.
